gap3OperationalizationProof.claim: getIndependenceReport (server/src/services/audits/auditTrailService.ts:269) previously had no caller anywhere outside its own route handler. At this SHA it has a real caller: server/src/jobs/auditIndependenceDetectorJob.ts:67 calls it inside scanBatch, which is driven by the fenced/checkpointed batch walker in server/src/services/audits/independenceScanCursor.ts, and server/src/cron/Scheduler.ts registers a `*/15 * * * *` cron entry (runAuditIndependenceSchedulerTick) that invokes it. What was NOT previously proven — only asserted from reading source — is that this actually works: claims a lease, scans a batch, produces findings, advances the cursor, releases, fences out a concurrent worker, and reclaims after a restart without starving old rows. This pass proves all of that against real PostgreSQL.
gap3OperationalizationProof.defaultOffIsFrozenDecision: AUDIT_INDEPENDENCE_DETECTOR_CRON_ENABLED defaults unset/false (Scheduler.ts:38). Per lane lead's explicit instruction, default-OFF is the frozen Audits rollout decision and is NOT a blocker for this task's closure; only proof that the runner functions correctly in both states (OFF = literal no-op, ON = correct fenced execution) was required.

testsRun.proves: flag OFF (default): the job module is never dynamically imported, no DB connection is taken, no lease claimed (2 cases). flag ON: exactly one claim per tick, fence advances by exactly one, lease released (1 case); an overlapping concurrent invocation while the lease is held claims nothing (1 case); two concurrent invocations never share a fence (1 case).

bounded batch fetch never over-returns; three batches walk distinct rows with no repeat/skip; COLD RESTART — a brand-new claim resumes from the persisted cursor, not from scratch; mutual exclusion — a live lease cannot be claimed by a second worker; FENCING — after lease expiry and takeover, the superseded worker cannot write progress (advanceAndRelease and releaseLeaseWithoutAdvancing both return false); the job surfaces a superseded tick as progressRecorded=false rather than silently succeeding; a failed tick releases without advancing so the batch is retried; STARVATION NEGATIVE — every row is visited within ceil(N/batch) ticks, the cycle wraps, and a second pass reaches all rows again; plus 8 migration-idempotency/preflight-fail-closed cases and fixture-cleanup-safety cases.
